text:
So generally, regular affidavits signed in front of a lawyer are not enough to replace a document in the partner visa process- you need a special type of affidavit. The types of affidavits approved for such cases under the partner visa protocols are as follows:

1. Consular affidavit in front of the Israeli embassy at a foreign country
2. Consular affidavit in front of the foreign embassy in Israel
3. Notarial affidavit with a notary abroad + apostille
4. Notarial affidavit with an Israeli notary in Israel

It's also important to know that these types of affidavits will be accepted only in cases where an official certificate is genuinely unattainable (for example, if the country of origin does not issue a personal status certificate at all).
